name: Tono-sama ga Koi Shita Sushiya
source:
It was a era of lords and servants------

The young master of a castle, Takeru, knew no other life. 
One day, however, he met a sushi man, and felt a stirring deep inside.

Experience their adventure firsthand. 
Erotic parody ADV game of Shink*nger.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE072038.html]DLsite English[/url]]
